name: Turbo Flow — the rig-lite kit
postCreateCommand:
chmod +x ${containerWorkspaceFolder}/rig-lite/*.sh ${containerWorkspaceFolder}/setup-harness.sh ${containerWorkspaceFolder}/workspace.sh 2>/dev/null || true; bash ${containerWorkspaceFolder}/rig-lite/self-test.sh; if ! command -v tmux >/dev/null 2>&1; then sudo -n env DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive apt-get update -qq >/dev/null 2>&1; sudo -n env DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive apt-get install -y tmux >/dev/null 2>&1 || echo 'WARNING: tmux install failed - the 5-window workspace will be unavailable until tmux exists; setup-harness itself still works'; fi; if ! grep -q 'tf-boot v2' "$HOME/.bashrc" 2>/dev/null; then if grep -q '^# tf-boot' "$HOME/.bashrc" 2>/dev/null; then sed -i.tfboot-bak '/^# tf-boot/,/^fi$/d' "$HOME/.bashrc" && rm -f "$HOME/.bashrc.tfboot-bak" || echo 'WARNING: old tf-boot hook could not be removed - ~/.bashrc may run it twice until cleaned manually'; fi; printf '
# tf-boot v2: first interactive shell gets the harness menu (once, atomic); every interactive shell lands INSIDE the tmux rig (TF_NO_TMUX=1 opts out of both)
if [[ -t 0 && -t 1 && -n "$TF_HOME" && "${TF_NO_TMUX:-0}" != "1" ]]; then
  if [[ ! -e "$HOME/.config/turbo-flow/harness-booted" && -f "$TF_HOME/setup-harness.sh" ]] && mkdir -p "$HOME/.config/turbo-flow" 2>/dev/null && mkdir "$HOME/.config/turbo-flow/harness-booted" 2>/dev/null; then
    ( cd "$TF_HOME" && bash ./setup-harness.sh )
  fi
  if [[ -z "${TMUX:-}" && -f "$TF_HOME/workspace.sh" ]] && command -v tmux >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    ( cd "$TF_HOME" && exec bash ./workspace.sh )
  fi
fi
' >> "$HOME/.bashrc"; fi
